Hop Step Idol.name: Hop Step Idol
Hop Step Idol.summary: Hop Step Idol * is a otome game, published by Media Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 1997 for the Sega Saturn.

Tetris Plus.name: Tetris Plus
Tetris Plus.summary: This is yet another updated version of Tetris which was released for PlayStation, Saturn, and Game Boy. This version features Classic mode, Puzzle mode, Versus mode, and Edit mode. In Puzzle mode, you must save the professor who climbs his way to the top. In order to do that, you must clear the blocks away and bring him to the bottom. Versus mode brings you head to head with another player. Edit mode allows you to create and save your own custom levels.
